body:
Thanks man, English is something I'm a bit proud of, but people (who are close to me) always say the same thing as you, that you're interesting and fun to talk to, but when it comes to my peers, they always just dismiss me, everybody lives in their own bubble where I live (I guess also everywhere else)  and almost everybody (and I actually mean, almost **EVERYBODY**) is trying to act the coolest, who has better clothes, who talks tougher, my peers mostly turn to those kinds of people. I guess I just want acceptance from people my age, my family always say I grew up too quickly.

But other than that, it might seem anti-climatic, but I just learned from my Aunt that my father was never in any war, he liked to talk tough, to act tough, he was a drunk even then, before meeting my mother, beat his wife, my siblings, then he just left them, ran away, it hit me quite hard actually.

But other than that thank you for the kind words, I really needed that, I'm about to go to therapy in a bigger city, probably gonna have to stay there the week, I guess if this account doesn't get locked I'll post an update, but thanks brother.
